user.title: Connect to your Hubitat hub
user.description: Provide the address of your Hubitat hub (or a Hubitat cloud Maker API URL), along with the app ID and access token of its Maker API instance. By default the hub sends events to Home Assistant through a webhook.

data_description.temperature_unit: This should match the temperature scale in your hub's settings.
data_description.sync_devices: Automatically remove devices that are no longer shared by Maker API after a successful device load.
data_description.sync_areas: Assign Home Assistant device areas to rooms reported by Maker API.
data_description.server_url: Webhook mode: the base URL the hub should use to reach Home Assistant (e.g., http://192.168.1.10:8123). Event server mode: the full URL Hubitat should POST events to. Leave empty to detect automatically.
data_description.host: The IP address or hostname of your hub, or a Hubitat cloud Maker API URL (https://cloud.hubitat.com/api/<hub UID>/apps/<app ID>).

legacy_event_server.name: Legacy event server
legacy_event_server.description: Only needed if Hubitat can't reach Home Assistant itself. Most setups should leave this off.

data_description.use_event_server: Receive events through a standalone event server instead of a Home Assistant webhook. Only needed if the hub can't reach Home Assistant's own address. Not available for hubs accessed through the Hubitat cloud.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect, please try again
error.cloud_requires_webhook: Hubs accessed through the Hubitat cloud must use webhook event delivery
error.no_public_url: Hubs accessed through the Hubitat cloud need Home Assistant Cloud, an external URL, or an event URL so the hub can send events

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect, please try again
error.cloud_requires_webhook: Hubs accessed through the Hubitat cloud must use webhook event delivery
error.no_public_url: Hubs accessed through the Hubitat cloud need Home Assistant Cloud, an external URL, or an event URL so the hub can send events
